bullets.text: Technology distributors Redington and Ingram Micro are benefiting from India's AI boom by expanding from iPhones and laptops to supplying AI infrastructure like GPUs.
The office should watch how hardware distributors leverage the artificial intelligence boom to ensure state technology supply chains remain robust and well-equipped.

stories.title: From iPhones to GPUs: Redington, Ingram Micro ride the AI boom
takeaways: Redington Ltd and Ingram Micro are emerging as major beneficiaries of India's artificial intelligence boom.
Both companies are expanding their traditional hardware supply models to include advanced AI infrastructure.
